responsibility: This file implements the main buffered diagnostics engine for the mc front end. It owns the error/warning tree and chaining structures, creates token-associated error objects, formats messages through DynamicStrings and FormatStrings, records fatal versus nonfatal diagnostics, supports multi-location chained messages, and finally flushes warnings or errors in source-location order using mcLexBuf token/file metadata, aborting compilation through M2RTS when fatal errors are present; it is the compiler's central diagnostic store-and-report subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Implements the diagnostic API declared in GmcError.h with the concrete error tree/chaining structures, message formatting, token-associated record creation, warning/error buffering, ordered flushing, and fatal-abort behavior. Unlike the header, it is the stateful diagnostics engine itself.
